topic.question: 生成式 AI 与教育公平 的主要证据、争议与空白是什么？
topic.description: 用户输入主题后现场检索生成的机器证据地图；非人工抽取，未人审。

claims.text: The findings underscore the need for responsible AI integration that ensures accessibility, equity, and innovation in educational systems.

claims.text: This study addresses three key inquiries: the role of Gen AI as a supportive instrument, essential technological features that foster inclusivity, and the ways in which Gen AI enhances access and participation.
claims.notes: 机器生成：摘要中的结果句，未人审

claims.text: African distance higher education is increasingly shaped by open educational resources (OER) and generative artificial intelligence, yet these agendas are often governed separately.

claims.text: Findings reveal that GenAI can bridge equity gaps by expanding access, providing personalized scaffolding, supporting multilingual and inclusive learning, and promoting teacher innovation, yet it can also widen disparities through infrastructural inequities, digital literacy divides, algorithmic bias, and English‐dominant linguistic norms.
claims.notes: 机器生成：摘要中的结果句，未人审

claims.text: The findings identify five psychological themes-cognitive offloading, AI self-efficacy, emotional responses, identity threat, and trust-and six equity dimensions-digital divide, disability access, first-language inequity, socioeconomic stratification, gender and race disparities, and Global South constraints.
claims.notes: 机器生成：摘要中的结果句，未人审

claims.text: Results indicated that AI-enhanced DDL was associated with significantly improved terminology mastery and cultural adaptation compared to traditional methods.
claims.notes: 机器生成：摘要中的结果句，未人审

claims.text: This perspective paper critiques the limited attention given to equity in the growing discourse on integrating generative AI into the introductory computer science sequence (CS1).

claims.text: Results show that students with stable connectivity, urban residence, and higher AI literacy gained greater academic benefits, while tribal students lagged in prompt-writing and application.
